title: Laredo Police to Open Applications Nov. 30
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department says applications to join the department open Monday, Nov. 30, and close Saturday, Dec. 12.
content:
The Laredo Police Department announced Monday that applications to join the department open Nov. 30 and close Dec. 12.

The department presented the opening as a chance to serve and protect the community, and asked residents whether they have what it takes to join Laredo PD.

The announcement did not include application requirements or a link to apply.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 23, 2026.
